instruction: A candid wedding photograph in a medium shot captures an intimate moment indoors. Against a clean white wall adorned with elegant floral arrangements, the groom in the dark suit (R1) stands on the left in profile, raising his arms to lift a sheer white veil over the head of the bride in the strapless white gown (R2). The bride stands on the right in profile, holding a pastel floral bouquet and looking up lovingly at him. The groom's hands gently hold the edges of the veil above her head. Soft, bright natural light illuminates the couple, casting gentle shadows and highlighting the romantic, neutral-toned setting.
